excluded_elements.deadweight_loss_copy: a second copy of deadweight_loss (API models only, different row counts); which one the paper used is not recorded
excluded_elements.exponential_discounting: time-consistency questions (STEER's time_inconsistency design), not the site's present_value element
excluded_elements.exponential_discounting_implicit: variant of exponential_discounting (time-consistency questions); no site element

provenance.rules: canonical = most recent complete non-broken run per model; broken = raw top token names a valid option in < 10% of rows

held_back.rule: open models with release mc on >= 80% of a benchmark's elements; closed models with any
